message.content: According to the conversation on 20261017 at 17:00, LiHua and Wolfgang discussed their shared interest in music and proposed organizing regular jam sessions. Wolfgang suggested starting the jam sessions around 8 PM, emphasizing that they would "just go with the flow and play some of our favorites." LiHua agreed and proposed that they should explore different songs together, highlighting their existing jam sessions with Yuriko Yamamoto, where they play music and share their favorite tracks. Both participants were enthusiastic about the idea, indicating that they intend to continue their musical collaborations and explore new tunes together.
